text:
rachel: Customer cust-504 reported embeddings suddenly changed width after we applied a variant pin for them. They call it a "vector length swap" — their downstream index fails. Ticket #C504-2412. Can we triage? They say it started immediately after the pinned model switch. :frown:

samir: Ack, looking. Can you paste the exact request + one example response (raw JSON) from the customer's call? Also which model string they were pinned to?

rachel: Here — API call they used (sanitized):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-alpha:pinned-v1",
  "input": ["summary of doc 123"]
}
```
And the response they saw (truncated):
```json
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.01,0.02,...],"index":0}],"model":"redwood-embed-alpha:pinned-v1","usage":{}}
```
But their expectation is 768 floats; this response is 512 floats (their client crashed on shape assertion). They attached a tiny diff showing length 512 vs expected 768.

mel: That suggests the pinned variant resolved to a different family/quantization than their previous unfrozen model. Two likely causes: alias mapping changed during the freeze, or we introduced a smaller-width embed baseline in that variant (eg. quantized/INT8 pipeline with embed pruning).

mel: Quick repro steps I want to run:
1) Call our internal model-spec debug endpoint to confirm the model metadata: `GET /internal/models/redwood-embed-alpha:pinned-v1/spec`
2) Hit embeddings with `batch_size=1` (to avoid batchpad) and `prefer_fast=false` flags.
3) Confirm the indexer consumer (cust side) expecting 768 — ask for their pinned model name and previous model name.

samir: I asked cust-504 for the previous model tag; they said it was `redwood-embed-alpha@2025-11-10` before we applied the pin earlier today. They're on our reserved pool in us-west-2 (customer note: high-throughput).

eng-ml-oncall: Jumping in. I ran a quick check against the pinned name in staging: the spec shows `embedding_dim: 512` for `redwood-embed-alpha:pinned-v1` — but the canonical catalog entry for `redwood-embed-alpha` (unfrozen) is `768`. Looks like the pin target resolved to a trimmed/legacy variant. Repro on my end:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-alpha:pinned-v1","input":["x"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# returns 512
```
So not a random batchpad effect.

eng-ml-oncall: Hypothesis: when the pin was created we allowed a variant alias that points to a lower-dim output for latency/cost reasons. That alias was chosen for the reserved pool mapping. I'll open ENG-ML issue and check variant alias history.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy note: pinned mapping updated 5171112000 by mel (change-id: ch-8492). No automatic rollback triggered.

samir: OK immediate mitigation for cust-504: 1) route their calls to `redwood-embed-alpha@2025-11-10` (unfrozen tag) via customer override, or 2) change their pin to the 768-dim variant. Which is faster?

mel: Fastest: update their pin to the explicit `@2025-11-10` tag (I can do that). Long-term: we need an alias validation that ensures pinned variant dim == expected dim for that customer. I'll add that to a follow-up ticket.

rachel: Customer is urgent — index pipeline failing in production. Please post ETA and I'll update ticket.

mel: I'll push the pin update in ~10m (need ops approval). If that succeeds I'll post call sample and length check.

eng-ml-oncall: Action items I created: ENG-ML-8471 (investigate alias->variant mapping), ENG-ML-8472 (add dim validation on pin), OPS-2910 (rollback pin for customer). Assigning to mel + eng-ml-oncall.

samir: I'll tell cust-504 the short-term plan and ask for a dump of one failing request/response payload (they said they can send). Also asking for their ingestion schema for the index so we can give migration steps. :thumbsup:

mel: Update: pinned->explicit update done at 5171112800. Verified with a test call:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-alpha@2025-11-10","input":["check"]}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# returns 768
```
Routing for cust-504 switched. Please confirm with customer.

rachel: Customer confirmed — index resumed, no more shape errors. They asked for a postmortem and an SLA credit request form.

eng-ml-oncall: I'll assemble short postmortem (root cause: pin resolved to lower-dim variant due to alias mapping during freeze). Will include remediation (pin-dim validation, better alias auditing, and a pre-pin compatibility check).

samir: Closing loop on ticket: advising cust on migration steps + ops rollback link. Will attach logs and the postmortem when ready. :white_check_mark:

mel: Filed follow-ups and will propose a pre-pin check in the console that shows "embedding_dim" before confirming pin.

rachel: Thanks all — marking P1 resolved for now.
